description: Utility functions for date and time operations, including comparisons, formatting, and timezone handling, used within the Mattermost web application.

methods.name: isWithin
methods.description: Checks if the difference between two dates is within a specified threshold for a given time unit.

methods.name: isEqual
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal within a threshold for a specific time unit.

methods.name: getDiff
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two dates in a specified time unit, considering timezone and endpoint truncation.

methods.name: isSameDay
methods.description: Determines if two dates fall on the same calendar day.

methods.name: isWithinLastWeek
methods.description: Checks if a date is within the last week.

methods.name: isSameMonth
methods.description: Checks if two dates are in the same month.

methods.name: isSameYear
methods.description: Checks if two dates are in the same year.

methods.name: isToday
methods.description: Checks if a date is today.

methods.name: isYesterday
methods.description: Checks if a date is yesterday.

methods.name: toUTCUnixInSeconds
methods.description: Converts a date to UTC Unix timestamp in seconds.

methods.name: relativeFormatDate
methods.description: Formats a date into a relative string like Today, Yesterday, or a specific format.
